statement: Every supersingular abelian threefold over an algebraically closed field of characteristic at least five is an actual direct summand of a product of Jacobians
depends_on: C.4h; C.4i; C.4p; Yu2017 Lemmas2.4 and3.2
notes: New affirmative family; explicit integral Bezout retraction. Supersingular characteristic-two bound is2 and characteristic-three bound is3; those cases not closed.
